DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, April 20, 2018 Posted by admin on April 20th, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include American Express (AXP). Dow stock 52 week lows include Procter & Gamble (PG). 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -10 points. 
Thursday the Dow was down -83.18 (-0.34%) at 24,664.89. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.22%. 
There were 8 Dow stocks up Thursday. 
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by American Express (AXP) +7.59% and General ELectric (GE) +2.42%. 
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Procter & Gamble (PG) -3.27% and Apple (AAPL) -2.83%. 
General Electric (GE +2.42%) rose 3% in premarket trading after it reported Q1 adjusted EPS of 16 cents, better than consensus of 12 cents. 
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended lower. 
The national average price of gasoline is up 1.2 cents at $2.751 per gallon.
